verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs say a new Journals page is created automatically each day at midnight with that day's date. Every launch opens on the Journals page, matching Roam's Daily Notes, so the automatic daily note and default landing place are well covered. Nothing in the pack shows journal pages being pre-filled from a template. Missing for 10: evidence of template-based pre-fill for daily journal pages, independent or hands-on corroboration of the journaling workflow.
